name: Fallout Shelter+
subtitle: Single-player switches, resource and dweller boosts, item picker.
description:
Tweak for Fallout Shelter: inject it into your own decrypted copy (Accretion offers it when you sign Fallout Shelter). No game files are hosted here; prebuilt .ipa files are never published.

Mod menu (tap the floating button). Everything works without JIT:
• Dwellers take no combat damage
• Incidents do no damage
• Weapon damage ×1-10
• Production and crafting speed ×1-10
• Training speed ×1-10
• Wasteland speed ×1-10
• Rushes always succeed
• Room output ×1-10
• Game speed ×1-5
• No damage from other sources
• No radiation
• No fires or infestations
• Caps gained ×1-10
• Keep food, water and power full
• Dwellers always happy
• Max SPECIAL for every dweller
• Fast level-ups
• Explorers return instantly
• Add a weapon / Add an outfit (rare and legendary)
• Keep screen awake

Also fixes a re-signed copy's main menu (it loads twice), so vaults open, and answers iCloud, Game Center, keychain and age-range requests that a re-signed copy can't get.

Checked against Fallout Shelter 2.7.0; on other versions missing hooks stay off.
